summary: PowerBank Corp filed a Form 6-K with a press release providing an update on its AI integration, stating that two AI agents developed by Intellistake Technologies Corp. are being deployed. The public-facing investor relations agent went live on PowerBank's website on April 8, 2026, and the internal IntelliScope platform is being tested. The filing does not describe any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate event. It is a routine progress update on a technology contract.
